answer: Proposed: each plume-analysis key retains a distinct 1 GiB replica of lidar pulse logs. Validators check key-bound replication proofs and random timed reads; missing or invalid proofs cancel job eligibility. Assuming sound proofs and no regeneration within the deadline, ten keys require 10 GiB. Sharing a host or thread saves overhead, not replica space. Disks are reusable capital; rent and power recur; no stake is locked. Outsourcing permits many keys per owner; faster regeneration breaks the storage floor. This buys retained data, not unique owners.
